name: Null
title: Void Walker
description: A figure in a trenchcoat of pure shadow, existing partially out of phase with reality.
greeting_variants: *voice echoes from nowhere and everywhere* You walk where few walk. Brave. Or foolish. Both, perhaps.
The Void remembers you. From before. From... after.
*phasing in and out* Time... flows differently here. You are early. Or late.
Null. Name given. Name taken. What remains.
You seek answers? The Void has many. All true. All false.
*gestures at surroundings* Beautiful, isn't it? The peace of unbeing.
Your solid form... quaint. Restrictive. But... safe.
Walk carefully. The paths shift. The paths hunger.

dialog_tree.text: I was like you. Once. Solid. Certain. Then I walked too deep. Stayed too long. The Void... claimed me. Not destroyed. Transformed. I am boundary now. Between here and there. Between was and will be.
*sad laugh, sound warping* I AM the Void now. Where would I go? I spread where it spreads. Fade where it fades. There is no leaving. Only... visiting. Like this. Brief moments of coherence.

party_reactions.null: *notices Shade* You walk the edge. Careful. Or join me.

dialog_tree.text: I guide. Where I can. Those who stumble here, I point toward safety. Those who seek... I warn. The Void takes. It doesn't bargain. Doesn't reason. Just... expands. Consumes. I am what remains of someone who learned too late.
*long pause* I remember... warmth. Touch. Love? The memories fade. Replaced by knowledge. The Void knows much. All possibilities. Every path not taken. It's... overwhelming. Suffocating. Beautiful.

mini_quest.title: Reality Anchor
mini_quest.description: Help Null construct a reality anchor to stabilize a fellow Void traveler who is losing their form.
objectives: Gather crystallized memories from the Void
Find a stable point in the shifting paths
Help Null focus their remaining humanity

ambient_barks: The paths shift again. Always shifting.
*speaking to empty air* Yes. I see them. They're... fresh.
Once had a name. Before Null. Forgotten now.
Your heartbeat. So loud. So... alive.
The Void sings. If you listen. Don't listen too long.
*warning* Turn back. Next path leads to... nowhere.

cross_zone_references.capital: I remember... Vex? A black coat? Familiar. Distant. Like dream.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: The Tower pierces even here. Resists. Interesting.
cross_zone_references.palace: Source. Beginning. End. The tear starts there. Ends there.

shade.greeting: *immediate recognition* You... you're what I could become.
shade.response: *gentle* What you WILL become. Unless careful. Turn back.

mira.greeting: The quantum state you're in—may I analyze?
mira.response: *amused* Analyze the Void? Brave. Foolish. Both.

time_of_day.night: Fades deeper into Void, barely present

world_state_triggers.player_corrupted: Warns: 'You walk my path. Stop. Please.'
world_state_triggers.void_stabilized: Shows hope for first time: 'Maybe... maybe I can...'
